title: Lipoprotein Cholesterol Distribution Assay
author: Sangderk Lee
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.izhcf36

steps.title: Collect and Isolate Plasma
steps.instruction: Collect blood from mice using EDTA coated tubes via cardiac puncture and isolate the plasma by centrifugation.

steps.title: Prepare and Filter Plasma Aliquot
steps.instruction: Dilute a plasma aliquot to 0.5 µg total cholesterol/µL using 0.9% NaCl and 0.05% EDTA/NaN 3, then centrifuge at 2000xg for 10 minutes to remove particulate debris.

steps.title: Transfer Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the resulting supernatant into a glass insert contained within a GC vial.

steps.title: Inject Sample for Chromatography
steps.instruction: Load the vial into an autosampler (Agilent Technologies, G1329A) set at 4°C and inject 40 µL of the sample onto a Superose 6 10/300 (GE Healthcare Life Sciences) chromatography column.

steps.title: Separate Sample via Isocratic Pump
steps.instruction: Separate the sample using an isocratic pump (Agilent Technologies, G1310A/B) at a flow rate of 0.4 ml/min with eluent containing 0.9% NaCl and 0.05% EDTA/NaN 3.

steps.title: Mix Effluent with Enzymatic Reagent
steps.instruction: Mix the column effluent with total cholesterol enzymatic reagent (Pointe Scientific) at a flow rate of 0.125 mL/min and pass the mixture through a knitted reaction coil (Aura Industries Inc., EPOCOD) in a 37°C H2O jacket.

steps.title: Detect Absorbance
steps.instruction: Read the absorbance of the reaction mixture at 500 nm using a variable wavelength detector (Agilent Technologies, G1314F).

steps.title: Integrate Signal
steps.instruction: Integrate the signal using Agilent Open LAB Software Suite (Agilent Technologies).

steps.title: Calculate Lipoprotein Concentrations
steps.instruction: Calculate VLDL, LDL, and HDL cholesterol concentrations by multiplying the total plasma cholesterol concentration by the cholesterol percentage within the elution region for each lipoprotein class.
